name: Youbaku Kitan
source:
When Takamichi's father dies exactly as the cards predicted, 
he is terrified. His death will surely come next. The only way to avoid it is to sacrifice someone in his place. An offering to the afterlife... 

A decaying mansion. 
A tormented young girl. 
The ingredients of destruction.
translation:
当高道的父亲如纸牌所预言的那样去世时，
他很害怕。接下来肯定会是他的死亡。避免这种情况的唯一方法就是牺牲某人来代替他。献给来世的祭品… 

一座破败的豪宅。
一个饱受折磨的年轻女孩。
破坏的成分。
